name: DNS Record Types Cheatsheet
summary: Searchable cheatsheet of DNS record types — A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, and DNSSEC records.
description: Browse and search common DNS resource record types with plain-language descriptions and copyable zone-file examples. Filter by category: address, mail, authority, service discovery, and security.

faqs.question: Which records are most common for websites?
faqs.answer: A or AAAA for the site IP, CNAME for www aliases, and TXT for SPF/DKIM/DMARC or domain verification.

faqs.question: Can I copy examples?
faqs.answer: Yes — click any record row to copy its example zone line to the clipboard.

faqs.question: Does this configure my DNS?
faqs.answer: No. This is a reference only. Changes are made at your DNS provider or registrar.
